category_title: Collaborative students capable of peer discussion and simple mathematical reasoning
scenario_title: Addition with regrouping and standard written form
minimal_context: The student is copying a horizontal math sentence from the blackboard into an exercise book to solve it using standard vertical form.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please copy the math sentence from the blackboard into your exercise book and change it to the standard vertical form.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slowly and carefully copies the horizontal sentence from the blackboard, but makes a mistake when setting up the numbers in the vertical form) I wrote it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, now go ahead and find the total.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Computes the numerals in the ones column) Eight and four makes twelve. (Writes the '1' in the ones place and carries the '2' to the tens column) Finished.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please check your answer to make sure it is correct.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks quietly at the exercise book for a moment, reviewing the carried '2' and the '1' in the ones place) I checked it. It is correct.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please copy the math sentence from the blackboard into your exercise book and change it to the standard vertical form.

STUDENT: (Slowly and carefully copies the horizontal sentence from the blackboard, but makes a mistake when setting up the numbers in the vertical form) I wrote it.

TUTOR: Okay, now go ahead and find the total.

STUDENT: (Computes the numerals in the ones column) Eight and four makes twelve. (Writes the '1' in the ones place and carries the '2' to the tens column) Finished.

TUTOR: Please check your answer to make sure it is correct.

STUDENT: (Looks quietly at the exercise book for a moment, reviewing the carried '2' and the '1' in the ones place) I checked it. It is correct.

task.content: Converting horizontal math sentences to standard vertical form and performing addition with regrouping

context.materials: Exercise book, blackboard, piece of paper with two leaves drawn on it

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Computing the numerals in the ones and writing the sum wrongly in case of addition with regrouping
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: They “carried” the wrong numeral to the tens and put the other numeral at the ones. They failed to identify the error when they checked their answers

behavior_patterns.condition: Instructed to copy mathematical sentences from the blackboard and change that to standard written form
